messages:
ravi: Pushing a quick prototype for eval-results list. Two main directions: compact linear list vs two-column summary + details. Concern: keyboard flow and bulk-approve UX. Thoughts?

zoe: Linear list for sure. Two-column breaks predictable tab order and hurts SR users. Linear keeps reading order simple.

marta: Linear okay but need to save vertical space. Idea: show compact row with headline metrics (score, pass/fail, diff-summary) and a chevron to expand details. Collapse metadata by default.

kevin: If we collapse, chevron must be a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Also add keyboard shortcuts: J/K to move rows, Enter to toggle. Document recommended behavior in handoff.

ash: Accessibility: color-only badges are problematic. Use text labels (OK/FL) + icons, and ensure contrast meets AA at 12px. For pass green, use #1f7a32 per earlier checks.

ravi: Good. Bulk approve requirement: confirmation sheet should list items and show provenance (author, last-run, prior approver). But don't slam the modal with 200 lines. Lazy-load details and show summary counts.

zoe: Modal must trap focus, Esc to dismiss, and announce progress via aria-live so SR users know when provenance is partially loaded: "Loaded 20 of 120 items". Include a small input: "auto-approve threshold" with tooltip.

marta: Diff rendering update: current approach injects tags and shifts text. Let's overlay highlights instead. Small CSS idea: .diff-token { position: relative; } .diff-token::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(255,235,59,0.18); pointer-events: none; } Make each token tabindex=0 and include data-change="added|removed" for SR reading.

kevin: If tokens are focusable, ensure focus outline is visible (not just color). Also provide a summary line at top of expanded details: "2 additions • 1 removal" so users get the gist without tabbing each token.

ash: Motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion for expand/collapse. If we animate height, provide a reduced-motion instant toggle. Also avoid parallax or long transitions.

ci-bot: ci: ui/evals-compact-proto built and deployed to staging at 2025-06-12T18:20:00Z

ravi: Nice. Small copy items: bulk CTA = "Approve selected"; single = "Approve". Confirmation modal copy: "Approving will record reviewer and timestamp. This is auditable." Add an optional comment box.

zoe: Microcopy for collapse chevron tooltip: "Show details (press Enter)" and for dense toggle: "Dense rows — more items per page". Both should be keyboard focusable with aria-describedby.

marta: Dev note: when loading provenance lazily, provide a spinner row and then progressively reveal details to avoid layout jank. Announce each batch load via aria-live.

kevin: QA checklist: keyboard nav Up/Down, Home/End, Enter toggles, Left/Right collapse, modal traps focus, aria-expanded states, live regions announce counts.

ash: Accessibility review scheduled. I'll run contrast and SR walkthrough on staging after the deploy.

ravi: Thanks all. I'll update the Figma frames with: compact linear rows + collapsed metadata + overlay diff highlights + bulk-approve modal with lazy provenance + reduced-motion variants. React with :thumbsup: to proceed, :eyes: to request copy review.

zoe: :thumbsup: 

marta: :eyes: please tag me for copy sign-off. 

kevin: :thumbsup:
